channel.title: WakeBuddy Blog
channel.description: Practical, research-backed advice on waking up, beating the snooze button and building better mornings, from the maker of WakeBuddy.

item.title: Does Turkey Make You Sleepy? The Tryptophan Myth, Explained
item.description: Turkey has about as much tryptophan as chicken or cheese. What really causes the post-Thanksgiving slump: meal size, the afternoon dip, alcohol, short sleep.

item.title: Why Do I Wake Up Tired? 9 Reasons (Even After 8 Hours of Sleep)
item.description: Why you wake up tired even after 8 hours: sleep inertia, an irregular schedule, alcohol, late caffeine, sleep apnea, and what actually helps.

item.title: How to Sleep Before an Early Flight (and Be Sure You Wake Up)
item.description: Can't sleep before an early flight? Why your brain won't switch off, when to go to bed, how much sleep to expect, and how to make sure you wake up on time.

item.title: AlarmKit Explained: Why Third-Party Alarms Can Finally Ring in Silent Mode
item.description: Before iOS 26, alarm apps couldn't ring through Silent mode like the Clock app. AlarmKit changed that. What it does, its limits, and how to check your app.

item.title: The Best Alarm for Heavy Sleepers: What Actually Gets You Up
item.description: Sleeping through alarms usually isn't about volume. Why heavy sleepers miss alarms, how six types of alarms compare, and a setup that works for most people.

item.title: How to Stop Hitting Snooze: 7 Fixes That Actually Work
item.description: More than half of mornings end with a snooze. Here's what sleep research says about the snooze button, and seven practical ways to get up on the first alarm.
